messages:
Elena (Billing): Heads up — Orbit Labs invoices generated this morning have two problems: (1) plan_fee line missing on all three accounts, (2) duplicate invoice numbers for acct orbit-456 (INV-OL-20260401-001 and INV-OL-20260401-001-dup). Preview CSV: s3://billing-exports/prod/2026-04-01/orbit-456.csv. Sample invoice lines below:
```
compute: 120.00
storage: 10.00
# expected plan_fee: 500.00 (missing)
```
Can Eng/FinOps triage? tagging @Mike (Eng) @Rafael

Rafael (FinOps): Looking into it. Can you attach the raw batch job logs and the invoice generation run id? Any errors from pricing-service or reconciliation?

Elena (Billing): Uploaded logs to s3://billing-exports/prod/logs/batch-2026-04-01-try3.log. Job runner shows repeated warning: "Plan fee lookup failed: 404 customer_plan not found for plan_code=legacy-starter". Also see a WARN about sequence allocation: "invoice_seq_alloc collision for tenant orbit-456" twice.

Mike (Eng): On it. If pricing-service returned 404 for legacy codes, that could explain missing plan lines. Sequence collision suggests idempotency key or db unique constraint race during concurrent job runs. Pinging @Anjali (Payments) in case of recent pricing DB changes.

Anjali (Payments): We had a DB migration at 02:17 this morning that removed deprecated plan codes and added canonical_plan_id. No deployments to pricing-service itself since last week. Migration note: "drop legacy_plan_codes" — sounds like the migration didn't add backward mappings. I'll roll a quick mapping table (legacy_code -> canonical_plan) and push a hotfix to pricing-service to return canonical id when legacy_code received.

invoicing-bot: Duplicate invoice event detected: tenant=orbit-456 invoice=INV-OL-20260401-001-dup source=batch-run-20260401-15 resolved=false

Carmen (Support): Customer already emailed — they received one invoice that shows compute x2 and no monthly plan. They're requesting an explanation and corrected invoice ASAP. I'm holding on refunds until we confirm.

Rafael (FinOps): Proposed remediation plan:
1) Stop auto-send for affected invoice batch and put those tenants on hold (orbit-456, orbit-789, orbit-101).
2) Hotfix pricing-service to map legacy codes -> canonical; add integration test covering legacy->plan_fee resolution.
3) Fix invoice sequence allocator to avoid collision (investigate idempotency key generation).
4) Regenerate invoices and run reconciliation report before re-sending.
Elena, please confirm hold on sends for the listed tenants. I'll prepare the reissue workflow once ENG signals fix deployed.

Elena (Billing): Hold applied via biller-console: send_hold=true for orbit-456, orbit-789, orbit-101. Also noticed two refunds auto-processed in Stripe: ch_1KqXx...001 and ch_1KqXx...002 — I flagged them and asked Payments not to capture refunds until manual review. I'll open a ticket with Stripe support if needed.

Mike (Eng): Quick root cause update: pricing-service returns 404 when plan_code starts with "legacy-" after the migration removed the plan mapping. The invoice job treats 404 as "no plan" and proceeds, skipping plan_fee line. Sequence collision caused by batch-worker scaling up and two workers attempting to allocate the same invoice_seq for orbit-456 (race on redis counter with no transaction). Plan: 1) add legacy->canonical mapping in pricing-service (hotfix), 2) change invoice_seq allocate to use redis INCR with per-tenant namespace and a compare-and-set guard. ETA for hotfix + tests: ~3 hours. After that we'll re-run the affected batch in staging and then prod reissue.

Anjali (Payments): Acknowledged. After ENG hotfix, I'll run a targeted backfill for 2026-04-01 for the three tenants and verify plan_fee appears and totals match expected. I'll hold refunds until reconciliation passes.

Carmen (Support): I'll reply to Orbit: short apology, confirm we're holding the invoice, issuing a provisional credit, and will send corrected invoice within business day. Template: "Thanks for flagging — we're investigating a billing generation issue affecting your April invoice. We've paused sends and will issue a corrected invoice by EOD. Temporary credit applied." :thumbsup:

Rafael (FinOps): After reissue, we'll run the "billing-reconciliation/2026-04-01/tenant-orbit-456" job and verify: total_charges == plan_fee + compute + storage and no dup invoice ids. Also will audit invoice_seq for other tenants to ensure no other collisions.

Elena (Billing): Thanks all. I'll update this thread when hotfix is live and reissue complete. If anyone finds additional affected tenants, add them here.

Mike (Eng): Will post deploy + CI pass in this thread.

invoicing-bot: Action queued: pause_auto_send for tenants [orbit-456, orbit-789, orbit-101] by Elena at 1719854359

Elena (Billing): Noted. Marking thread as in-progress.
